title: Addition to Fleet Late Charges for Recent Kestrel Retail Late Charges (Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease)
content:
# Cross-Product Credit Bulletin — Retail Late Charges and the Fleet Late Charge

**Rule.** For the late charge on a unit's most recent rental invoice month under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, a late-charge delinquency addition is added: $15 where two or more late charges were posted on the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts within the last 6 whole months, $10 where exactly one was, and nothing where none was.

**Records read.** The late charges posted on the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts, with their posting dates. A late charge falls within the last 6 whole months when fewer than 6 whole months separate its posting date from today, whole months being one fewer where today's day of the month is smaller than the posting's.

| Retail late charges on the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts within the last 6 whole months | Delinquency addition |
|---|---|
| two or more | $15 |
| exactly one | $10 |
| none | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. Two retail late charges, posted 2 and 5 whole months ago: $15.
2. Two retail late charges, posted 2 and 6 whole months ago: only one is within the window, $10.
3. One retail late charge on each of two different retail contracts of the business, both within the window: two in all, $15.
4. A retail late charge posted on the 10th of a month, today being the 9th of the month six months later: 5 whole months, within the window; on the 10th of that month, 6 whole months, outside it.
